title: Engine strength and power
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly discuss engine strength, power, and refinement, with praise for strong performance but a few complaints about weak output or vibration.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the engine as strong, powerful, excellent, and in some cases both smooth and economical.

negative.summary: Negative reviews report that some engines feel unimpressive or underpowered, and one example mentions annoying vibration from the 3-cylinder engine.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention the engine or describe it as strong without enough context to confirm clear praise or criticism, though one fragment says it feels a bit underpowered.

limitations: The sampled fragments are short and many undetermined examples lack enough context to resolve sentiment confidently.
This topic is based on a stratified sample of fragments and should not be treated as representative of all F70 engine feedback.
Some undetermined fragments use positive-sounding words such as 'strong' but are labeled undetermined, so their sentiment cannot be reclassified from the excerpt alone.
